metadata.description: Agent Treasury by Tempora Labs — treasury management plugin for AI agents. Open source, starting with yield on idle USDC and USDG: vaults on Base, Arbitrum One, Robinhood Chain, Ethereum and Monad through the Tempora API, and on Solana from the chain; every step checked before your wallet sees it; unsigned deposit and withdraw steps for your own signer or your own browser wallet. Never holds a key.

plugins.name: treasury
plugins.description: Agent Treasury by Tempora Labs — treasury management plugin for AI agents; your own wallet holds the position. Ships the earn skill: vaults listed by the Tempora API (Solana read from the chain), every step checked before your wallet sees it, unsigned deposit/withdraw steps, and a local confirm page for your own wallet. Holds no keys.
